title: SpeedByp* open source
features:
A script designed to bypass WalkSpeed protection systems that automatically reset your character’s movement speed.
It allows you to set and maintain any custom speed you choose, even in places with speed-restricting mechanisms.
Useful for experimentation or analyzing basic anti-speed systems in Roblox maps.

Note:
To change the speed, simply edit the number 50 in the code to your preferred speed.
Example:

local desiredSpeed = 100 Change this value

This script is open source. You are free to modify, improve, or use it in any project without restrictions
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local desiredSpeed = 50 -- السرعة اللي تبيها

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local humanoid = char.Humanoid
        if humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= desiredSpeed then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = desiredSpeed
        end
    end
end)
